docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
William Q. Judge’s interpretation of Patañjali’s Yoga Sūtras, written for Theosophical students and first published in 1889, with his comments on each aphorism. Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The yoga aphorisms of Patanjali : an interpretation, [the thought of Patanjali clothed in our language] · Patañjali, Judge, William Quan, 1851-1896 · 1920, 114 scanned pages. Published 1920 (first published 1889); William Quan Judge died 1896; the Yoga Sūtras are ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
